messages:
maria: Heads-up: planning a rolling maintenance across us-east1 + eu-west1 to address a NIC microburst + thermal calibration. Window: Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC. Expect staggered node warmdowns and controlled egress bandwidth slicing. Any tenant-heavy jobs that need to be excluded? Fallback is burst-capacity pool + canary checks.

infra-bot: Maintenance ticket RW-4873 created and scheduled for Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC. Affected pools: gradient-pool, saturn-pool. Estimated impact: transient latency variance during warmdown.

aj: Noted. Can we limit slicing to 60% egress so model-serving latency doesn't spike? :thinking_face:

maria: Yes — plan is to cap egress per-cohort at 60% and route >95th pct traffic to burst-pool. We'll prime KV cache and run a short canary first.

kevin: kv-seed script OK to run? Last time it caused a short CPU spike on controllers.

infra-bot: Runbook snippet: ```for node in $(list_nodes gradient-pool); do kubectl drain $node --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120; sleep 30; done``` Use the `--grace-period=120` for high-priority tenants.

sre-oncall: @maria add a canary for model-rr (2 replicas) in us-east1 before the full roll. I'll watch p95/p99, OOMs, and exporter errors.

maria: Good call. Canary scheduled 03:00-03:10 UTC. If p95 latency > 250ms for 2 consecutive samples we'll rollback NIC driver change and disable slicing.

aj: Cost note: routing to burst-pool uses reserved burst credits — rough estimate ~$1.2k/hr if fully used. Recommend notifying finance for pre-approval.

finance-liaison: Thanks, can you post expected hours per region and pool? We'll pre-approve up to $5k for emergency burst usage.

maria: Quick worst-case numbers: 2 GPUs * 100 instances * 1 hour across both regions ~= $2.4k. Will refine after canary.

kevin: Also double-check netpol on egress-peers — last patch accidentally blocked our monitoring agents in eu-west1.

maria: Already on it. We'll add a monitoring-only allowlist during the slice window and validate visibility before drain.

aj: :thumbsup: I'll be on call for the window and will monitor traces/dashboards.

maria: Thanks all — posting a follow-up with exact node lists and the canary job id in 30m. If anyone wants exclusion, ping here or DM before EOD.
